# SuperWitness

> Observability and evaluation for agent fleets: what an agent did, how the product it ran on behaved, and whether the work was any good, joined on one run.

SuperWitness is a self-hosted service that joins a SuperPipeline run, its AgentPod attempts, spans, logs and verdicts into one run document, readable through an HTTP API, an MCP server and a web app. It is MIT licensed, installs on Linux and macOS, and a real deployment is one Linux host with systemd running SuperWitness next to Postgres.

## Docs

- [What it is](https://docs.superwitness.dev/what-it-is/): the product and what it is for
- [Install](https://docs.superwitness.dev/install/): install the binary and run it
- [Concepts](https://docs.superwitness.dev/concepts/): runs, attempts, telemetry and verdicts
